### Field Map

<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/leaflet/1.9.4/leaflet.css" crossorigin=""/>
<script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/leaflet/1.9.4/leaflet.js" crossorigin=""></script>

<div id="map-legend" style="display:flex; gap:1.25rem; flex-wrap:wrap; align-items:center; margin: 0.75rem 0 0.5rem; font-size: 0.9rem; color:#555;"></div>

<div id="trial-map" style="height: 420px; border-radius: 8px; overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid #ddd; margin: 0.5rem 0 1.25rem;"></div>

<script>
// Create the map and basemap right away, independent of the data fetch,
// so a data-loading problem shows an empty (but visible) map rather than
// a blank container.
const trialMap = L.map('trial-map', { scrollWheelZoom: true }).setView([48.55, -123.05], 10);

L.tileLayer('https://{s}.basemaps.cartocdn.com/light_all/{z}/{x}/{y}{r}.png', {
  attribution: '&copy; <a href="https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright">OpenStreetMap</a> contributors &copy; <a href="https://carto.com/attributions">CARTO</a>',
  maxZoom: 19
}).addTo(trialMap);

fetch('data/trials.json')
  .then(r => {
    if (!r.ok) throw new Error(`data/trials.json request failed: ${r.status}`);
    return r.json();
  })
  .then(trials => {
    // Legend: one entry per distinct project present in the data.
    const legendEl = document.getElementById('map-legend');
    const projectsSeen = new Map();
    trials.forEach(t => {
      if (!projectsSeen.has(t.project)) projectsSeen.set(t.project, t);
    });
    legendEl.innerHTML = Array.from(projectsSeen.values())
      .map(t => `<span style="display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:0.4rem;"><span style="font-size:1.2rem;">${t.icon}</span>${t.project_label}</span>`)
      .join('');

    const bounds = [];
    trials.forEach(t => {
      // Plain icon, no background shape -- just the emoji sitting on the map.
      const icon = L.divIcon({
        className: 'trial-marker',
        html: `<div style="font-size:22px; line-height:1; text-align:center; filter: drop-shadow(0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.45));">${t.icon}</div>`,
        iconSize: [28, 28],
        iconAnchor: [14, 14]
      });

      const marker = L.marker([t.lat, t.lon], { icon }).addTo(trialMap);

      const time = t.start_time
        ? new Date(t.start_time).toLocaleDateString(undefined, { dateStyle: 'medium' })
        : 'unknown date';

      marker.bindTooltip(
        `<strong>${t.project_label}</strong><br>${t.trial} &middot; ${time}`,
        { direction: 'top', offset: [0, -14] }
      );

      bounds.push([t.lat, t.lon]);
    });

    if (bounds.length) trialMap.fitBounds(bounds, { padding: [40, 40], maxZoom: 13 });
  })
  .catch(err => console.error('Could not load trial map data:', err));
</script>
